subject: Heads-up: I killed API servers on ports 7908/7909 from worktree agent-a287f9a5…
body: My e2e failed on 'port 7908 already used'; I assumed leftovers and pkill'd uvicorn processes with --port 790[789], which were from worktree agent-a287f9a5bde952e94 (another agent). If that agent's e2e broke, that was me; its ports collide with the +1/+2 ports Playwright derives from E2E_PORT 7907 (mine). I moved to E2E_PORT=7917.
